referenceSources.title: Nissan S14 custom wheels Enkei RPF1 17x9.5, ET -2, tire size 235/40 R17. 17x10.0 ET+18 235/40 R17
referenceSources.description:
A 1997 Nissan S14 coupe is showcased in bright white paint, rolling on green Enkei RPF1 wheels. The front wheels measure 17x9.5 inches with an effective -2mm offset and 5.17" backspacing, while the rear wheels are 17x10.0 inches with a +18mm offset and 6.21" backspacing. Wrapped in Maxxis MA-Z1 Drift 235/40 R17 tires, the setup delivers a classic deep-dish drift stance.

Underneath, KTS coilovers, SPL tension rods, outer tie rod ends, TEIN Z33 inner tie rods with spacers, and SPL subframe spacers refine the suspension geometry. A NISMO power brace adds chassis rigidity, and Z32 30mm front brakes improve stopping power. Inside, Sparco Pro2000 seats and harnesses are visible, along with a bold "15" decal and "D2K" marking on the windshield, highlighting its track-focused modifications.
